title: Bundesregierung
description: The official styleguide of the German Federal Government (styleguide.bundesregierung.de) defines a 17-colour spectrum: Violett (#5F316E), Dunkelrot (#780F2D), Rot (#C0003C), Orange (#CD5038), Hellorange (#F7BB3D), Gelb (#F9E03A), the greens #C1CA31, #597C39, #005C45 and #00854A, the teals #00818B and #007194, Hellblau (#80CDEC), Blau (#0077B6), Dunkelblau (#004B76), Dunkelgrau (#576164) and Hellgrau (#BEC5C9).
